name: spinshare
description: SpinShare extension: wraps terminal AI agents and shows ads during AI generation wait states. Compatible with VSCode, Trae, and Cursor.

spinshare.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the SpinShare web application.

spinshare.terminalAutoWrap.description: When enabled, new integrated terminals resolve configured AI agent commands through SpinShare shims before the real command runs.

spinshare.terminalAgents.description: Command names SpinShare should auto-wrap in new integrated terminals.

spinshare.claudeCodeAdapter.description: When enabled, SpinShare installs Claude Code hooks/statusLine integration into ~/.claude/settings.json with a backup.

spinshare.autoUpdate.description: When enabled, SpinShare periodically checks the configured base URL for a newer published version and installs it in place (the editor does not auto-update sideloaded extensions). You are always asked before the window reloads.

scripts.package: corepack pnpm@9.12.0 --filter @spinshare/cli build && corepack pnpm@9.12.0 build && node ./scripts/package-variant.mjs prod
scripts.package:prod: corepack pnpm@9.12.0 --filter @spinshare/cli build && corepack pnpm@9.12.0 build && node ./scripts/package-variant.mjs prod
scripts.package:local: corepack pnpm@9.12.0 --filter @spinshare/cli build && corepack pnpm@9.12.0 build && node ./scripts/package-variant.mjs local
scripts.package:all: corepack pnpm@9.12.0 --filter @spinshare/cli build && corepack pnpm@9.12.0 build && node ./scripts/package-variant.mjs prod && node ./scripts/package-variant.mjs local
scripts.publish:prod: corepack pnpm@9.12.0 --filter @spinshare/cli build && corepack pnpm@9.12.0 build && node ./scripts/publish-prod.mjs
